value.rationale: A complete two-state sharp classification reveals that the preferred timing of identical suppression resources depends on initial fire size, and that a capacity-one model cannot exhibit this reversal. The exact all-duration mixture boundary is a natural and useful counterexample to a naive universal early-intervention ordering for an extinction-only endpoint; no field-management claim is made.
